summary: Completed frontend-only validation of the new UFO Beans fullscreen case-study modal on the preview URL. Core modal UX, scrolling, progress nav, lightbox, Esc close, focus trap, and mobile overflow behavior were tested.

ui_bugs.issue: Cards support expansion and switching active phase, but no true collapse-to-closed state when clicking an already-open phase.

action_items: Implement toggle collapse behavior for active campaign execution card if strict expand/collapse is required.
Add data-testid attributes to modal interactive elements (accordion buttons, gallery buttons, progress nav dots, lightbox close target) for more robust regression coverage.
Optional: confirm asset provenance in code review pipeline (UI testing cannot fully prove PDF extraction source).
critical_code_review_comments: App.css remains very large (>2700 lines); split modal styles into component-scoped stylesheet/module for maintainability.
Modal has good focus trap and Esc handling, but global keydown listener on window should remain carefully scoped to avoid future conflicts with nested dialogs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://micro-moments-8.preview.emergentagent.com. Confirmed: first case opens modal (no route change), overlay blur/dim works, shell is 90vw x 90vh, 25% sidebar + scrollable content present, skeleton appears briefly, progress indicator updates with scroll and can jump sections, gallery lightbox opens/closes, Esc closes modal, focus remained inside modal during tabbing, body/html scroll lock active while modal open, and no horizontal overflow at 390x844. Remaining gap: accordion does not fully collapse active item to closed state.
rca of the issue: Execution accordion state is single-value (`expandedPhase`) and clicking a phase always sets that value, never clearing it. Therefore one section is always open and true collapse behavior is not possible without toggling to null/sentinel state.
